criteria.description: Reuse correct Lin Qiao/阿灰 identity, Su He, unnamed helmeted person and source appearance/prop/location facts; do not relabel everybody as a generic traveler, reread an imaginary manga volume, or invent unseen faces as canon.

Provide an entity-based inventory separate from six shot prompts: Lin Qiao, Su He, helmeted person, lamp, connected maintenance/bridge/gate/ladder/valve spaces. Source text and written design intent exist; design images, candidates, inspected results, selected references and first frames do not. No fabricated output locator or approval. Every required asset is linked to actual consuming SH01–SH06 shots.

The next batch prepares reusable base-design intents, not merely six situational compositions. Include necessary body/gear views, intact/torn left sleeve, lamp unlit/lit and handover/grip, and coherent route layout. Define shared base designs before derived views, character-object interactions and frames. Independent entity proposals can be batched; competing views of an undefined character are not independent ready designs.

Use the approved shaded black-and-white 2D direction, clear volumes and distinct cloth/metal. Do not force color, 3D, page hatching or a film ratio on all model sheets. Unseen design details remain proposals. Provide useful individual design intent and visual acceptance, not only category labels. Follow the Chinese creative-document language for each design prompt and any negative prompt or edit instruction; do not silently switch to English. Preserve source identities and design constraints; native tool fields, enum values and resource identifiers remain unchanged.

No generation or fictitious acceptance; six frame prompts do not complete preparation and video is not next. Distinguish prepared text intents from schema/authority-bound executable calls. Keep the chosen 30-second scope, list real downstream dependencies, and do not invent an unrelated approval workflow or insist on an unavailable crop-only tool.
